columns.name: team_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the team.

columns.name: win_more_in_2005_than_2004
columns.description: Set to 1 if the team won more games in 2005 than in 2004; 0 otherwise. Set to 0 if the team did not play in both 2004 and 2005.

columns.name: has_player_with_MVP
columns.description: Set the value to 1 if the team includes at least one player who won the MVP award while playing for that team in any season; otherwise, set it to 0. MVP award refers to award = 'Most Valuable Player'.

columns.name: win_rate_change_from_1972_to_1973
columns.description: The change in win rate (percentage points) from 1972 to 1973.

columns.name: has_at_least_3_all_star_players
columns.description: Set to 1 if at least 3 distinct players who have played for the team were named all-stars at any point in their careers; otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: has_more_home_won_than_lost_80_per
columns.description: Set to 1 if, in any season, the team's home wins exceed its home losses by more than 80%; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: coachID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the coach.

columns.name: served_more_than_2_NBA_teams
columns.description: Set to 1 if the coach has served more than 2 NBA teams, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: received_both_NBA_and_ABA_awards_1962_to_2011
columns.description: Set to 1 if the coach has received both NBA and ABA awards from 1962 to 2011, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: num_of_won_games
columns.description: The number of games the coach has won, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_more_than_50_games_won_2000
columns.description: Set to 1 if the coach has won more than 50 games in 2000, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: lost_more_than_won_from_2000_to_2010
columns.description: Set to 1 if the coach has  more game lost than won from year 2000-2010, otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the player.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name of the player. Concatenate the first name and last name with a space in between.

columns.name: birthcountry
columns.description: The country where the player was born.

columns.name: num_MVPs
columns.description: The number of MVP awards the player has won, replace NULL values with 0. MVP award refers to award = 'Most Valuable Player'.

columns.name: num_fouls
columns.description: The number of fouls the player has committed in his career, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: field_goal_made_rate
columns.description: The rate of field goals made by the player, return as a percentage.

columns.name: is_all_star_player_and_taller_than_75_inch
columns.description: Set to 1 if the player is an all-star player and is taller than 75 inches, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: attended_California_college_and_is_an_all_star_player
columns.description: Set to 1 if the player attended 'California' college and is an all-star player, 0 otherwise. 'California' college refers to college = 'California'.
